title: Irrational
subtitle: irrational = 不理性的；不合理的；不合邏輯的；沒有充分根據的
description: irrational = 不理性的；不合理的；不合邏輯的；沒有充分根據的

words.note: 當 irrational 指要求、決定、反應或期望超出合理範圍時，unreasonable 很自然。
words.example: It is unreasonable to expect one employee to do the work of three people.

exercises.original: It is irrational to expect one employee to do the work of three people.
exercises.zh: 要求一名僱員完成三個人的工作並不合理。
exercises.upgrade: unreasonable · 不合理的；不合情理的

options.explanation: expectation 超出合理負荷，重點是要求不合情理。
可表示推理錯誤，但這裡核心是要求過分。
工作可能並非完全不可能，只是不合理。

exercises.original: The landlord's demand for six months' rent in advance seemed irrational.
exercises.zh: 業主要求預付六個月租金，看來並不合理。
exercises.upgrade: unreasonable · 不合理的；不合情理的

options.explanation: demand 過度，最自然用 unreasonable。
通常形容 fear、claim、suspicion 等缺乏證據，不適合要求本身。
預付六個月可能做得到，只是不合理。
副詞，seemed 後需要形容詞。

exercises.original: The deadline was irrational because the team had only one day to finish the entire report.
exercises.zh: 這個限期不合理，因為團隊只有一天完成整份報告。
exercises.upgrade: unreasonable · 不合理的；不合情理的

options.explanation: 時間要求超出合理可行範圍。
deadline 本身不是推理論證。
表示經過推理，意思相反。

words.meaning: 不合邏輯的；邏輯錯誤的
words.note: 當 irrational 指論證、推理或結論在邏輯上有問題時，illogical 最精確。
words.example: The argument is illogical because its conclusion does not follow from the evidence.

exercises.original: The argument is irrational because its conclusion does not follow from the evidence.
exercises.zh: 這個論證不合邏輯，因為結論並不是由證據合理推導出來。
exercises.upgrade: illogical · 不合邏輯的；邏輯錯誤的

options.explanation: conclusion does not follow 是典型邏輯錯誤線索。
較廣泛，未能精確指出推理結構錯誤。
偏缺乏證據，而此句強調推導關係錯誤。

exercises.original: It is irrational to say that all expensive products must be high quality.
exercises.zh: 認為所有昂貴產品必定高質素是不合邏輯的。
exercises.upgrade: illogical · 不合邏輯的；邏輯錯誤的

options.explanation: 由價格高直接推出質素高，推理不成立。
可表示缺乏根據，但這裡更精確是邏輯推論錯誤。

exercises.original: The conclusion seemed irrational because it contradicted the report's own evidence.
exercises.zh: 這個結論似乎不合邏輯，因為它與報告本身的證據矛盾。
exercises.upgrade: illogical · 不合邏輯的；邏輯錯誤的

options.explanation: 結論和自己的證據矛盾，明顯是推理問題。
帶強烈嘲諷，不如 illogical 精確。
副詞，seemed 後需要形容詞。

words.meaning: 沒有根據的；缺乏證據支持的
words.note: 當 irrational 指恐懼、懷疑、指控或信念沒有可靠證據支持時，unfounded 很自然。
words.example: Her fear that the building would collapse was completely unfounded.

exercises.original: Her fear that the building would collapse was irrational because engineers had confirmed it was safe.
exercises.zh: 她擔心大樓會倒塌，但工程師已確認安全，因此這種恐懼沒有根據。
exercises.upgrade: unfounded · 沒有根據的；缺乏證據支持的

options.explanation: 工程師已有相反證據，因此恐懼缺乏事實支持。
可能接近，但重點不是推理步驟，而是沒有證據基礎。
恐懼當然有情緒，但 emotional 不等於沒有根據。

exercises.original: The rumour that the company was closing was irrational and unsupported by any evidence.
exercises.zh: 公司即將倒閉的傳聞沒有根據，亦沒有任何證據支持。
exercises.upgrade: unfounded · 沒有根據的；缺乏證據支持的

options.explanation: unsupported by any evidence 幾乎直接定義 unfounded。
帶評價色彩，但不精確指證據不足。

exercises.original: The accusation appeared irrational because no witness or document supported it.
exercises.zh: 這項指控看來沒有根據，因為沒有證人或文件支持。
exercises.upgrade: unfounded · 沒有根據的；缺乏證據支持的

options.explanation: 缺乏證人和文件支持，最直接就是沒有根據。
不一定是推理形式錯誤。
副詞，appeared 後需要形容詞。

words.meaning: 未經理性思考的；缺乏推理的
words.note: 較正式，表示一個判斷、立場或決定並非由清晰推理支持。
words.example: The committee rejected the proposal on what appeared to be unreasoned grounds.

exercises.original: The committee's rejection seemed irrational because no reasons were given.
exercises.zh: 委員會的否決看來缺乏理性依據，因為沒有提出任何理由。
exercises.upgrade: unreasoned · 未經理性思考的；缺乏推理的

options.explanation: no reasons were given 直接指出判斷沒有清楚推理支持。
偏缺乏證據，而不一定是沒有提出理由。

exercises.original: His refusal was irrational and appeared to be based on no clear argument.
exercises.zh: 他的拒絕缺乏理性依據，看來沒有任何清楚論據支持。
exercises.upgrade: unreasoned · 未經理性思考的；缺乏推理的

options.explanation: no clear argument 表示沒有理性推理支持。
可能有情緒，但原句沒有說。
拼法和詞形都錯；標準副詞是 unreasonably。

exercises.original: The decision looked irrational because it was made without examining the available information.
exercises.zh: 這個決定看來缺乏理性思考，因為作出決定前沒有檢視已有資訊。
exercises.upgrade: unreasoned · 未經理性思考的；缺乏推理的

options.explanation: 沒有先檢視資訊便作決定，顯示缺乏推理過程。
表示有理有據，意思相反。

words.note: 語氣較強，表示某行為、暴力、損失或決定看不出任何合理目的或道理。
words.example: The destruction of the equipment was completely senseless.

exercises.original: The destruction of the equipment was irrational and served no useful purpose.
exercises.zh: 破壞這些設備毫無道理，而且沒有任何有用目的。
exercises.upgrade: senseless · 毫無道理的；荒謬的

options.explanation: served no useful purpose 明確表示行為毫無道理。
即使由情緒引起，也不等於核心意思。
破壞已經發生，不是不可能。

exercises.original: The vandalism seemed irrational because nothing was stolen and no message was left.
exercises.zh: 這宗破壞行為看來毫無道理，因為沒有東西被偷，也沒有留下訊息。
exercises.upgrade: senseless · 毫無道理的；荒謬的

options.explanation: 看不出目的或理由，最適合 senseless。
沒有證據顯示情緒驅動。

exercises.original: The repeated damage to the public garden was irrational and achieved nothing.
exercises.zh: 反覆破壞公共花園毫無道理，而且完全沒有達成任何目的。
exercises.upgrade: senseless · 毫無道理的；荒謬的

options.explanation: achieved nothing 表示行為沒有合理目的。
通常形容指控、恐懼或信念。

words.meaning: 受情緒支配的；由情緒推動的
words.note: 當 irrational 指決定或反應主要由恐懼、憤怒、焦慮等情緒推動，而不是由理性分析決定時，可用 emotion-driven。
words.example: The purchase was an emotion-driven decision rather than a carefully planned one.

exercises.original: The purchase was irrational because he bought the car immediately after becoming excited at the showroom.
exercises.zh: 這次購買受情緒支配，因為他在陳列室一時興奮便立即買車。
exercises.upgrade: emotion-driven · 受情緒支配的；由情緒推動的

options.explanation: immediately after becoming excited 明確表示決定主要由情緒推動。
表示基於證據，方向相反。
可形容決定，但未指出情緒是主因。
副詞，不能直接修飾 decision。

exercises.original: Her irrational response came mainly from panic rather than from the facts.
exercises.zh: 她的反應主要來自恐慌，而不是事實，因此受情緒支配。
exercises.upgrade: emotion-driven · 受情緒支配的；由情緒推動的

options.explanation: panic rather than facts 是最直接線索。
是名詞，不能直接修飾 response。

exercises.original: The investor made an irrational decision after becoming frightened by one negative headline.
exercises.zh: 投資者因一則負面標題而害怕，之後作出受情緒支配的決定。
exercises.upgrade: emotion-driven · 受情緒支配的；由情緒推動的

options.explanation: fear triggered the decision，明顯是情緒而非完整分析主導。
一則標題不足以表示完整證據分析。

words.meaning: 難以解釋的；難以理解的
words.note: 當某個行為看起來缺乏可理解的理性原因時，可用 inexplicable。它不一定表示邏輯上錯誤，而是「難以合理解釋」。
words.example: His sudden refusal to speak was inexplicable to everyone in the room.

exercises.original: His sudden refusal to speak seemed irrational because nobody could identify a reason for it.
exercises.zh: 他突然拒絕說話令人難以理解，因為沒有人知道原因。
exercises.upgrade: inexplicable · 難以解釋的；難以理解的

options.explanation: nobody could identify a reason 表示行為難以合理解釋。
可能由情緒造成，但沒證據。

exercises.original: The sudden change in his behaviour was irrational and puzzled everyone.
exercises.zh: 他的行為突然改變，令人難以理解，也令所有人困惑。
exercises.upgrade: inexplicable · 難以解釋的；難以理解的

options.explanation: puzzled everyone 表示沒有人能理解原因。
副詞，was 後需要形容詞。

exercises.original: The machine stopped for an irrational reason that the engineers could not identify.
exercises.zh: 機器因一個工程師無法找出的原因而停機，情況令人難以解釋。
exercises.upgrade: inexplicable · 難以解釋的；難以理解的

options.explanation: 工程師無法找出原因，表示原因難以解釋。
機器故障原因本身不是一個論證。
詞性不合。 --- End of teaching material

falseSynonyms.zh: 情緒化不等於不理性 emotional 只表示情緒強烈；一個情緒化反應仍然可以有合理原因。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON She was emotional, but her concerns were not irrational.

falseSynonyms.zh: 愚蠢不等於 irrational stupid 是較強、較主觀的批評，可指缺乏常識或能力；irrational 更精確地指缺乏合理推理。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON A decision can be irrational without proving that the person who made it is stupid.

falseSynonyms.zh: 不可能不等於不合理 impossible 表示某事不能發生或完成；irrational 表示推理、反應或信念不合理。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON An idea may be irrational even if it is technically possible.

falseSynonyms.zh: 錯誤不等於不理性 false 表示不真實；一個錯誤信念可能來自合理但不完整的資料，不一定 irrational。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON A belief can be false without being irrationally formed.

falseSynonyms.zh: 荒謬可笑不等於所有 irrational ridiculous 帶很強評價色彩，表示荒唐到令人發笑或難以認真看待；irrational 更偏理性和推理層面。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The claim sounded ridiculous, but the report focused on whether it was rationally supported.

falseSynonyms.zh: 有偏見不等於不理性 biased 表示判斷偏向某一方；偏見可以導致 irrational decisions，但兩者不是同義詞。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON A biased decision may also be irrational, but bias and irrationality are different problems.

falseSynonyms.zh: 形容詞和名詞不同 irrational 是形容詞；irrationality 是名詞，表示不理性。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The fear was irrational. The decision revealed a degree of irrationality.

falseSynonyms.zh: 意思相反 rational 表示合乎理性、基於理由；irrational 表示缺乏合理理由或邏輯。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON A rational decision is supported by reasons; an irrational one is not.
